title: Private endpoints and closing the public path for good

videos.script: Every Azure database is born with a public name, reachable from the whole internet, guarded by a firewall and a password. {{born}} A private endpoint gives it an address inside your own network instead. {{inside}} The hard part is not the endpoint. It is DNS: making the same name answer with the private address. {{dns}} And the last part is closing the public path, so that nobody can open it again by accident. {{end}}
